name: MCP-Universe
intro: MCP-Universe 以真实 MCP 服务和客观执行式评估器测试智能体的工具使用能力。论文构建了位置导航、代码仓库管理、金融分析、3D 设计、浏览器自动化和网页搜索六个领域的 231 个任务，覆盖 11 个服务器、133 个工具和 84 个唯一评估器。
build_method: 人工任务构思, 最多五次尝试内的难度筛除, 其他作者交叉核验, 执行式评估器
metric: 成功率 (SR), 平均评估器得分 (AE), 成功任务平均步数 (AS)
modality: 文本, 结构化输出, 环境状态
eval_feature: 真实 MCP, 多工具编排, 执行式评估, 动态真值
scale: 231 个任务, 11 个服务器, 133 个工具, 84 个唯一评估器
build_method_en: Manual Task Brainstorming, Difficulty Screening within Up to Five Attempts, Other-author Cross-check, Execution Evaluators
eval_feature_en: Real MCP, Multi-tool Orchestration, Execution-based Evaluation, Dynamic Ground Truth
intro_en: MCP-Universe tests agent tool use with real MCP services and objective execution evaluators. The paper constructs 231 tasks in six domains—location navigation, repository management, financial analysis, 3D design, browser automation, and web search—covering 11 servers, 133 tools, and 84 unique evaluators.

drawio_review_note: Evidence-aligned reconstruction against arXiv:2508.14704v1 (the sole arXiv revision; paper PDF SHA-256 19a07fb6e2ec4185c05b729b5285d697ba2c00a1ccd4e7be2860236c731929b7), the paper-date source snapshot 7a804f820b844859d771b44a6d1ff7d9ff7bd884, and stable release v1.1.3 at 63fb05cee17538eb2ca7ac886a8fe74b5f9e0b4b. The stable benchmark data tree a28ba506583c988f0724ecac649966f9f4fbd4f7 is unchanged at inspected HEAD 48b453021694d9823d308627fb7f6b7edd29541a, but 102 non-data files changed between v1.1.3 and that HEAD, so core/code is not claimed unchanged. Paper construction is shown as manual 4–5-type/domain task brainstorming; redesign of tasks solvable without MCP or stably solved within up to five attempts, which is construction screening rather than an evaluation retry policy; other-author checks for feasibility, ambiguity, and correctness; and 84 objective execution evaluators (4 format, 32 static, 48 dynamic), not an LLM judge. Stable-release audit found six domain manifests referencing 231 unique task JSONs (45/33/40/19/39/55), while 232 JSONs exist and browser_automation/playwright_huggingface_task_0008.json is unreferenced; 169 referenced tasks specify output_format, 62 include cleanups, and 767 evaluator-rule entries provide 1–16 checks/task. Cleanup is therefore limited to those 62 tasks: configured operations run in reverse, while exceptions are logged and execution continues, making cleanup best-effort rather than a guaranteed rollback. All 231 referenced tasks set use_specified_server=true and contain 385 mcp_servers entries whose only key is name; zero entries name individual tools, so the flag restricts listed servers while every tool schema returned by those servers remains exposed. Paper Table 3 uses ReAct for the main experiment except GPT-OSS through the OpenAI Agent SDK, Appendix D sets temperature 1.0, and GPT-OSS has no AS score. Public YAML is a separate drifting artifact: snapshot 7a804f8 configures location, repository, and finance with explore_and_exploit; v1.1.3 instead uses function_call for finance and harmony_react for web search, with iteration caps also changing, so those YAML choices are not presented as the paper-main agent setup. Execution then performs ReAct JSON parsing/tool calls where applicable, evaluator-expression parsing, binary all-required-check success, and SR/AE/AS computation. Public task text, formats, static ground truth, dynamic evaluator code, and Apache-2.0 source are separated from required credentials/accounts/Blender, unpinned external server revisions/live data, and the post-paper mutable website leaderboard. The live site inspected 2026-07-21 exposes four tracks—Overall, LLM with ReAct, LLM with Function Calls, and Agent—and currently contains internal result drift: its narrative still says GPT-5 is best at 43.72 SR, while the tables show 44.59 for the leading Function Calls entry and 44.16 for the leading ReAct entry. The public repo report stops at per-task check fractions; the paper aggregate script, fixed run seed, repeat/variance protocol, annotator count/agreement, and rejection log are not reported. The README path configs/test is stale relative to stable/current configs/mcpuniverse.
